description: This file defines a React functional component 'VectorStoreSelector' that fetches and displays a list of vector stores in a multi-select dropdown, allowing users to select multiple vector stores. It manages state for the list of vector stores and loading status, and fetches data asynchronously upon mount or when the accessToken changes.

methods.name: VectorStoreSelector
methods.description: React functional component for selecting vector stores; fetches data from network and renders a multi-select dropdown.
